qkd-survey-scope: Section I, p.2: the paper states its own coverage in the quoted sentence; read in context with the next sentence listing the five covered categories.
qkd-survey-excludes-transfer-learning: Section I, p.2: same paragraph states that quantum transfer learning and quantum-state distillation are distinct and not typically included, unless a teacher-student distillation objective is involved. The value carries that condition.
qkd-survey-contribution-taxonomy: Section I.A, p.2, contribution 3: the paper states it proposes this taxonomy with these four dimensions and separate quantum-enhanced and quantum-inspired categories. A statement of its own contribution.
qkd-definition-quantum-kd: Section III.A, p.5: the paper's working definition of quantum KD. The text says 'generally defined as', and the next sentences state the survey adopts it as its focus.
qkd-configuration-taxonomy: Section III.A, p.5 and Fig. 2: the paper defines the four teacher-student combinations and says C2C is conventional KD. Table II lists the three quantum directions.
qkd-definition-quantum-enhanced: Section III.A, p.6 (page 5 text): the paper defines quantum-enhanced distillation as a complementary category, quantum resources inside the mechanism with classical teacher and student.
qkd-definition-quantum-inspired: Section IV.E, p.14: the paper defines quantum-inspired KD in the first sentence of the section. The value matches the full sentence, including the quantum-derived construction.
qkd-alpha-extremes: Section II.C, p.4, Eq. 7: L_total = (1-alpha)L_task + alpha L_distill. The two extremes follow directly from the paper's own definition of the objective.
qkd-benchmark-hardware-count: Section VI, p.15: the paper's tally of its own 33-study set. Table II (page 6) gives hardware counts 3+2+0+1 = 6 over 18+9+2+4 = 33 studies, so the count agrees with the table. Cited-study properties are tabulated by the survey itself, so I grade it as the scope of the surveyed set.
qkd-benchmark-classical-baseline-count: Section VI, p.15: the paper's tally of its own 33-study set. Table II classical-comparison column 10+3+1+4 = 18 agrees. Graded as the scope of the surveyed set.

theory_low.qkd-class-probability-from-outcomes: Section III.B, p.6: a method statement with conditions for applying KL. It is stated, not proved, and is not a theorem or a definition. The conditions are quoted correctly.
theory_low.qkd-pauli-expectation-range-limited: Section III.B, p.7: Eq. 14 bounds the class probability by e^(2/tau)/(e^(2/tau)+C-1). The paper gives the bound with no derivation, and the quotes drop the bound itself. Not a proved result.
theory_low.qkd-tau-squared-quantum-loss-weight: Section III.B, p.8: an authors' argument with no derivation. The value matches the text, but it is interpretation, not a proved result.
